question: Does a text-disjoint reference/dispatch construction preserve native capability for a zero-fit Q8 causal-suffix operation confirmation?

authority.design_basis: The complete sealed-v10 atlas identified causal suffix sources with value-dominant, opposing-pattern computation; v11 is capability-only and cannot inspect that intervention.

frozen_design.novelty: Disjoint reporter/object rotation plus new reference/near and dispatch/behind constructions; retain reliable Next-year/Last-year semantics and exactly one changed cue token.
frozen_design.measurement: Capability only: native base/donor margins, with no head, subspace, source-factor, weight-mode, or causal intervention.

predictions.pred_a_authority: The bank is text-disjoint from v10, cue-token aligned, and has exact row counts.
predictions.pred_b_joint_capability: At least 28 jointly correct rows per A1/A2 panel.

decision: Manifest only if all gates pass. Only a manifest licenses the frozen zero-fit v11 operation confirmation.
